scenes.name: Gentle block · 3%
scenes.description: Seattle Craftsman wood houses and conifers on gently rising residential street, 3% longitudinal slope, low 0.3m exposed foundations, shallow entry steps, 2% street crown. Keep floors and roof ridges level.

scenes.name: Moderate block · 10%
scenes.description: San Francisco compact Victorian bay-front houses on 10% uphill street, each house stepped separately up the block, level floors, uphill shallow foundation and downhill exposed 1.2m foundation for 12m along-slope footprint, alternating elevated porch entries and garage-at-grade lower level; bay visible only distant, no Chicago landmarks.

scenes.name: Steep block · 22%
scenes.description: Los Angeles hillside contemporary stucco and wood houses along steep 22% street, level floor slabs, terraced pads, 2.64m downhill foundation difference across12m footprint, split-level entries, lower garages reached from street, retaining walls and separate stairs, dry chaparral and oak hills, do not tilt buildings.

scenes.name: Steep corner lot
scenes.description: San Francisco bay-front corner house at intersection with main street20% longitudinal grade and side street6%, garage at downhill side-street level, main entry reached from uphill street via stairs, level floor bands, clearly stepped perimeter foundations, localized intersection transition, no folded road or cliff at curb, stairs and retaining wall wrapping corner.

scenes.name: Stair street
scenes.description: Pittsburgh hillside public stair street between brick houses, pedestrian-only continuous broad concrete stair flights with landings every8risers, uniform .16m risers and .30m treads, two simple continuous handrails, walking route running beside stepped retaining walls and level terraced houses, no vehicle road pretending to climb stairs, leafy steep river valley far view.

scenes.name: Retaining-wall street
scenes.description: Kansas City hillside shirtwaist wood-over-brick houses with stone base piers, uphill raised lawns and 1.2m limestone retaining walls fronting sidewalk, stair breaks to porches, variable 0.6–1.8m walls but smooth level tops in terraces, rolling hills, broad deciduous canopy, road10% downhill, each house floor level.

scenes.name: Canyon edge
scenes.description: San Diego mesa edge Spanish revival stucco houses terraced alongside8%street, lower side reveals deep natural canyon with dry chaparral and coastal scrub, each floor level, small retaining wall supports actual house pad, untouched steep natural ravine slopes distinct from road slope, broad matte terrain shapes, no invented house overhang or floating foundation, distant coast subtle.

sources.claim: 2015 specification: bare-earth hydroflattened 1 m cells; 10 km square blocks with 6 m overlap. Resolution is not accuracy.
All 3DEP products are public domain. A separate third-party ancillary dataset needs its own license review.
QL2 target: 10 cm RMSEz, 1 m DEM, nominal pulse spacing <=0.71 m. Check each project's quality metadata.
1 m DEM uses UTM; preserve actual horizontal and vertical datum from tile metadata.
Official catalog API for product metadata and footprint queries; six-city complete 1 m coverage not verified in this pack.
Incline may be percentage, explicit degrees or qualitative up/down; sign follows way direction. Qualitative tags do not provide a numeric grade.
OSM is ODbL, with attribution and applicable database share-alike requirements; public-domain DEM does not erase OSM obligations.

Design maxima: principal/commercial 9%, collector/minor 10%, residential access/alleys 17%; usual crown and sidewalk cross slope 2%, curb 6 inches. These are design criteria, not observed city maxima.
Retaining structures support grade differences where allowable ground slopes are exceeded. Project approval and design remain necessary.
LA manual preferred street grade <=6%; major highway desirable 6%, absolute 7%; other streets normally 15%. Applicability and exceptions require project review.
2024 Street Design Manual: typical crowned streets use 2% cross slope. Full current maximum grade table not verified.
City identifies adopted public works/design standards. No existing maximum street-grade record verified here.
Curb wheels on perceptible grades; uphill with curb turn away, downhill toward curb. This is wheel orientation, not permission to rotate parking bays to arbitrary angles.
Public stair streets are a real part of Pittsburgh's mobility network. Individual dimensions and condition need mapping/survey.
Covered stair flights: uniform risers 4–7 inches, uniform treads at least 11 inches. Scope matters; this is not a universal survey of residential stairs.
Stairs alone are not an accessible route. Generated scenes must not label a stair-only route accessible.
Screen-space error governs terrain refinement (default 2); terrain depth tests/LOD can affect surface objects, shadows add cost. A map-engine reference, not a measured WorldEngine budget.
three.js supplies distance-based LOD; screen-error selection and stable anchoring proposed here need application logic.
Indexed vertex geometry is supported by BufferGeometry.
RealityKit LowLevelMesh supports custom vertex formats and CPU/compute updates; MeshDescriptor is a simpler alternative. Prefer baked static meshes here.

materials.surfacePolicy: Simplified matte albedo fields. Recesses and trim are selective geometry; no photo textures, brick grain, asphalt noise, pores or procedural dirt.
materials.glass: Restrained dark panes with broad reflections; no mirrored photographic panorama.
materials.foliage: Irregular organic lobed crowns, selective silhouette detail; no repeated spherical clusters, no dense leaf microgeometry.
materials.detailLevel: Real proportions and silhouette; selective structural detail, simplified surface information.

peopleVehicles.policy: Near-photoreal generic form under the same matte lighting, no brands, detailed faces, readable signage or insignia.

distanceBands.people: Real anatomy, gait, clothing folds at broad scale; non-identifying facial planes, no detailed features.
distanceBands.vehicles: Real class proportions, wheels, broad glass and panel forms; no badge, identifying grille or plate text.

distanceBands.people: Natural pose and clothing colour groups; facial detail removed.
distanceBands.vehicles: Silhouette, wheel placement, glass groups; merge small trim.

distanceBands.people: Natural uninflated silhouette and muted colour groups.
distanceBands.vehicles: Real class silhouette, subdued broad glazing, no trim.

distanceBands.policy: Cull ambient actors below visibility threshold; never inflate actors.

peopleVehicles.selection: Projected size determines detail; metre bands are illustrative and depend on FOV, viewport and camera.
